packageRules.description: Language/interpreter runtimes are never automerged by Renovate itself. The rule above automerges every digest/pin/patch/minor update, and Renovate calls a Python 3.12->3.14 bump 'minor' because 3.x IS the minor field in its version model -- so without this an interpreter upgrade self-merges on the daily run. Must stay AFTER that rule: package rules apply in order, last match wins. The renovate-automerge CronJob holds these too, but it is a separate mechanism and does not govern Renovate's own merging.

George's own images (ghcr.io/gjcourt/*) are tagged YYYY-MM-DD-<sha7> (legacy: YYYY-MM-DD, YYYY-MM-DD-N). Renovate's default docker versioning reads 2026-07-26-c14b782 as version 2026 with suffix -07-26-c14b782 and only offers tags with the SAME suffix, so it never proposed a newer build. This regex versioning orders the date as major.minor.patch, keeps the legacy -N as a build number, and ignores the sha (unnamed group: matched, never compared). Two builds on the same day therefore compare equal: Renovate takes whichever tag sorts last (the lexically greatest sha), which is not necessarily the newest build, and it will not move between builds of the same day; the next day's build supersedes them. These PRs are deploys of George's own code, so they are never automerged; this rule must stay AFTER the automerge rule above (last match wins). matchCurrentValue leaves non-date pins (latest, bare sha) on docker versioning.
